regime_context: The detector ranks Gold Miners and Industrial Metals as the clear leaders (scores ~2.1 and ~1.3), with Gold Miners having high durability (0.91) and trend health but no ETF proxy for grading. Breadth of rotation is narrowing (8/22 eligible), and the backtest verdict is explicit that the trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on China A-shares history — so leadership here is an attention lens only, not an alpha signal.
emerging_watch: Watch Industrial Metals (512400.SS) for a confirmed leadership handoff: if its score closes the 0.80 gap to Gold Miners and its breadth exceeds 0.9 while Gold Miners' durability bar falls below 0.85, that would mark a real rotation within Cyclicals & Resources. Retire the watch if the score gap widens back above 1.0.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the highest-scoring scorable theme (rank 2, score 1.302), eligible, with moderate durability (0.72) and high-but-not-perfect breadth (0.846). It is adjacent to the Gold Miners leadership among Cyclicals & Resources and has a tradeable proxy (512400.SS). The crowding flag is benign (z=-0.13). This is a lean on the persistence of the resource-leadership structure, not a momentum alpha claim.
theses.dissent: The overall A-share tape mean-reverts (gate_helps=false), so any trend-following lean lacks a validated drawdown-control edge here; Industrial Metals' 'mixed' Hurst tag means the move is not a clean trend and could reverse within days.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS closes below its 20-day moving average and the duration bar on Industrial Metals drops below 0.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma & CXO is the only crowded theme in the top ranks (crowding_z 1.15, crowded=true) while still eligible (rank 5, score 0.508). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution — not a fade — but combined with only mid durability (0.52), mixed Hurst tag, and narrow breadth (0.357), there is no reason to add exposure here absent a fresh catalyst.
theses.dissent: Crowding is a coincident texture, not a sell signal; healthcare can decouple from the resource narrative on policy or licensing news, and an avoid lean costs nothing if the tape rejects the resource leaders.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ (Innovative Pharma & CXO proxy) breaks above its 20-day high and crowding_z normalizes below 0.5 while breadth expands above 0.6 before the check-by date

theses.subject: AI Compute & Optics
theses.thesis: AI Compute & Optics holds rank 3 (score 1.285) but shows a mean-revert Hurst tag, very narrow breadth (0.294), and low durability (0.42). Despite macro attention on ai_tech in the narrative backdrop, the detector texture is not supportive of a durable trend: this looks like a narrowing, fading pulse rather than a cohesive leadership. A lean away from this theme while it remains unconvincing aligns with the trend-discipline lens.
evidence: macro_narrative shows ai_tech as a top theme but unscheduled_share 0.88 (noise)
theses.dissent: AI is a structural macro theme with recurring catalysts; mean-reversion in the detector does not preclude a sharp repricing higher on a single headline given the 0.88 unscheduled-surprise share in this market.

falsifier.text: 515000.SS (AI Compute & Optics proxy) gains 8% or more from the as-of date while its durability_bar rises above 0.6 and breadth expands above 0.5 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
